Junior fourth rank, upper grade — Vice Director of the Palace Secretariat; vice directors of the Eight Directorates; Vice Director of the Palace Directorate; Heir Apparent Left and Right Guards; Imperial Escort, Clear Way, Inner Rate, and Gate Vice Rate commanders; Heir Apparent Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guard Middle Commandants; Heir Apparent Household, Timing, and Stable Directors; Palace Attendant; Chief Administrator of Princely Establishments under Great Protectorates — the above are executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: Middle commandants are military offices; the rest are civil — Master of Free Counsel, a civil honorary rank; Robust Martial General, a military honorary rank. Junior fourth rank, upper grade — Vice Director of the Palace Secretariat; vice directors of the Eight Directorates; Vice Director of the Palace Directorate; the Heir Apparent's Left and Right Guards; Imperial Escort, Clear Way, Inner Rate, and Gate Vice Rate commanders; Heir Apparent Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guard Middle Commandants; the Heir Apparent's Household, Timing, and Stable Directors; Palace Attendant; and Chief Administrator of Princely Establishments under Great Protectorates — all executive offices.

sentences.zh: 府率、中郎將為武，余並為文、太中大夫文散官、宣威將軍武散官、輕車都尉勳官從第四品下階國子司業、少府少監、將作少匠、京兆、河南、太原府少尹、大都督府、大都護府、親王府司馬、上州別駕已上職事文官。

translations.literal: Rate commanders and middle commandants are military; the rest are civil — Grand Master of Palace Counsel, civil honorary rank; Proclaimer of Might General, military honorary rank; Commandant of Light Chariots, merit rank. Junior fourth rank, lower grade — Vice Chancellor of the National University; Vice Director of the Palace Workshops; Junior Artisan of Construction; Vice Intendants of the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures; Marshals of Princely Establishments under Great Area Commands and Great Protectorates; Vice Prefect of a superior-grade prefecture — the above are civil executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: Rate commanders and middle commandants are military offices; the rest are civil — Grand Master of Palace Counsel, a civil honorary rank; Proclaimer of Might General, a military honorary rank; and Commandant of Light Chariots, a merit rank. Junior fourth rank, lower grade — Vice Chancellor of the National University; Vice Director of the Palace Workshops; Junior Artisan of Construction; Vice Intendants of the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures; Marshals of Princely Establishments under Great Area Commands and Great Protectorates; and Vice Prefect of a superior-grade prefecture — all civil executive offices.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》，上州別駕正五品上。

translations.literal: Under the Wude Code, the Vice Prefect of a superior-grade prefecture was senior fifth rank, upper grade.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Wude Code, the Vice Prefect of a superior-grade prefecture ranked senior fifth rank, upper grade.

sentences.zh: 二十三年為長史，前上元年，復置別駕，定入從四品也、中府折沖都尉武職事官、中大夫文散官、明威將軍武散官。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year it became chief administrator; before the first year of Shangyuan, the vice prefect was restored and fixed at junior fourth rank. Army-Suppressing Commandant of a middle-grade prefecture — military executive office. Palace Counselor — civil honorary rank. Bringer of Might General. Military honorary rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year the post became chief administrator; before the first year of Shangyuan the vice prefect was restored and fixed at junior fourth rank. Army-Suppressing Commandant of a middle-grade prefecture — a military executive office. Palace Counselor — a civil honorary rank. Bringer of Might General. A military honorary rank.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》有天策上將府從事中郎，九年省。

translations.literal: The Wude Code had Attending Gentleman of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief's Office; abolished in the ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: The Wude Code provided for an Attending Gentleman of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief's Office; the post was abolished in the ninth year.

sentences.zh: 正第五品上階諫議大夫、御史中丞《武德令》，從五品上。

translations.literal: Senior fifth rank, upper grade — Remonstrance Official and Censor-in-Chief: under the Wude Code, junior fifth rank, upper grade.
translations.idiomatic: Senior fifth rank, upper grade — Remonstrance Official and Censor-in-Chief ranked junior fifth rank, upper grade under the Wude Code.

sentences.zh: 《貞觀令》，加入正五品上，五年又加入四品。

translations.literal: The Zhenguan Code added them to senior fifth rank, upper grade; in the fifth year again added to fourth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenguan Code placed them at senior fifth rank, upper grade; in the fifth year they were again raised to fourth rank.

sentences.zh: 如意元年復舊也、國子博士、給事中、中書舍人、太子中允、太子左右贊善大夫、都水使者、萬年、長安、河南、洛陽、太原、晉陽、奉先、會昌縣令武德元年敕：萬年、長安令為正五上。

translations.literal: Restored in the first year of Ruyi — Erudite of the National University; Drafting Officer; Secretariat Drafting Officer; Heir Apparent Middle Attendant; Heir Apparent Left and Right Moral Guides; Waterways Commissioner; magistrates of Wannian, Chang'an, Henan, Luoyang, Taiyuan, Jinyang, Fengxian, and Huichang — Wude first-year edict: Wannian and Chang'an magistrates were senior fifth rank, upper grade.
translations.idiomatic: Restored in the first year of Ruyi (692) — Erudite of the National University; Drafting Officer; Secretariat Drafting Officer; Heir Apparent Middle Attendant; Heir Apparent Left and Right Moral Guides; Waterways Commissioner; and magistrates of Wannian, Chang'an, Henan, Luoyang, Taiyuan, Jinyang, Fengxian, and Huichang — a Wude first-year edict made the Wannian and Chang'an magistrates senior fifth rank, upper grade.

sentences.zh: 七年定令，改為從五品。

translations.literal: The code fixed in the seventh year changed them to junior fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The code promulgated in the seventh year reassigned them to junior fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 貞觀初復舊也、親勳翊衛羽林郎將、中都督府、上都護府長史、親王府諮議參軍事《武德令》，正五品下也、軍器少監、太史少監、親王府典軍已上職事官。

translations.literal: Restored at the beginning of Zhenguan — Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guard Commanders of the Forest of Feathers; chief administrator of a middle protectorate; chief administrator of a superior protectorate; advisory military aide of a princely establishment — under the Wude Code, senior fifth rank, lower grade; Vice Director of the Armory; Vice Director of the Astrological Service; military aide of a princely establishment — the above are executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: Restored at the beginning of the Zhenguan era — Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guard Commanders of the Forest of Feathers; chief administrator of a middle protectorate; chief administrator of a superior protectorate; and advisory military aide of a princely establishment ranked senior fifth rank, lower grade under the Wude Code; Vice Director of the Armory; Vice Director of the Astrological Service; and military aide of a princely establishment — all executive offices.

sentences.zh: 郎將、典軍為武，余並為文。

translations.literal: Commanders and military aides were military offices; the rest were civil.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders and military aides were military offices; the rest were civil.

sentences.zh: 《永徽令》，親王典軍從四品下。

translations.literal: The Yonghui Code made the military aide of an imperial prince junior fourth rank, lower grade.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yonghui Code the military aide of an imperial prince ranked junior fourth rank, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 《垂拱令》改入五品也。、

translations.literal: The Chuigong Code changed it to fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Chuigong Code reassigned it to fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 中散大夫文散官、開國子爵、定遠將軍武散官、上騎都尉勳官正第五品下階太子中舍人、尚食、尚藥、奉禦、太子親勳翊衛郎將、內常侍、中都督、上都護府司馬、中州別駕、下府折沖都尉已上職事官。

translations.literal: Master of Palace Attendance, civil honorary rank; Founding Viscount, noble rank; General for Settling the Distant, military honorary rank; Supreme Commandant of Cavalry, merit rank. Senior fifth rank, lower grade — Heir Apparent Drafting Officer; Providers of Food and Medicine; Heir Apparent Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guard Commanders; Regular Palace Attendant; middle protector; marshal of a superior protectorate; Vice Prefect of a middle-grade prefecture; Army-Suppressing Commandant of a lower-grade prefecture — the above are executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: Master of Palace Attendance, a civil honorary rank; Founding Viscount, a noble rank; General for Settling the Distant, a military honorary rank; and Supreme Commandant of Cavalry, a merit rank. Senior fifth rank, lower grade — Heir Apparent Drafting Officer; Providers of Food and Medicine; Heir Apparent Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guard Commanders; Regular Palace Attendant; middle protector; marshal of a superior protectorate; Vice Prefect of a middle-grade prefecture; and Army-Suppressing Commandant of a lower-grade prefecture — all executive offices.

sentences.zh: 郎將、折沖為武，余並為文也、朝議大夫文散官、寧遠將軍武散官。

translations.literal: Commanders and army-suppressing commandants are military; the rest are civil — Court Consultant, civil honorary rank; General for Pacifying the Distant, military honorary rank.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders and army-suppressing commandants are military offices; the rest are civil — Court Consultant, a civil honorary rank; and General for Pacifying the Distant, a military honorary rank.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》有天策上將軍諮祭酒，九年省。

translations.literal: The Wude Code had Army Staff Sacrificer of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief; abolished in the ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: The Wude Code provided for an Army Staff Sacrificer of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief; the post was abolished in the ninth year.

sentences.zh: 從第五品上階尚書左右諸司郎中《武德令》，吏部郎中正四品上，諸司郎中正五品上。

translations.literal: Junior fifth rank upper grade. Bureau Directors of the left and right bureaus of the Department of State Affairs — under the Wude Code, the Personnel Bureau Director was senior fourth rank, upper grade; other bureau directors, senior fifth rank, upper grade.
translations.idiomatic: Junior fifth rank, upper grade. Bureau Directors of the left and right bureaus of the Department of State Affairs — under the Wude Code, the Personnel Bureau Director ranked senior fourth rank, upper grade, and the other bureau directors ranked senior fifth rank, upper grade.

sentences.zh: 貞觀二年，並改為從五品上也、秘書丞《武德令》，正五品上。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenguan, all were changed to junior fifth rank, upper grade. Deputy Director of the Palace Secretariat — under the Wude Code, senior fifth rank, upper grade.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenguan, all were reassigned to junior fifth rank, upper grade. Deputy Director of the Palace Secretariat — under the Wude Code, senior fifth rank, upper grade.

sentences.zh: 《永徽令》改也、著作郎、太子洗馬、殿中丞、尚衣、尚舍、尚乘、尚輦、奉禦、獻陵昭陵恭陵橋陵八陵令《武德》，諸陵令從七品下，永徽二年加獻、昭二陵令，為從五品。

translations.literal: Changed under the Yonghui Code. Compiler; Heir Apparent Reader; Vice Director of the Palace Directorate; Providers of Robes, Lodgings, Transport, and Palanquins; Directors of the eight imperial tombs including Xian, Zhao, Gong, and Qiao — under the Wude Code, tomb directors were junior seventh rank, lower grade; in the second year of Yonghui the Xian and Zhao tomb directors were added at junior fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: It was changed under the Yonghui Code. Compiler; Heir Apparent Reader; Vice Director of the Palace Directorate; Providers of Robes, Lodgings, Transport, and Palanquins; and Directors of the eight imperial tombs including Xian, Zhao, Gong, and Qiao — under the Wude Code, tomb directors ranked junior seventh rank, lower grade; in the second year of Yonghui the Xian and Zhao tomb directors were added at junior fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 已後諸陵並相承依獻、昭二陵也、親王府副典軍、下都督府、上州長史、下州別駕已上職事官。

translations.literal: Thereafter all tomb offices followed the precedent of the Xian and Zhao mausoleums. Deputy Martial Director of Princely Establishments; Chief Administrator of lower protectorates and superior prefectures; Vice Prefect of an inferior-grade prefecture — the above are executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter all tomb offices followed the precedent set by the Xian and Zhao mausoleums. Deputy Martial Director of Princely Establishments; Chief Administrator of lower protectorates and superior prefectures; and Vice Prefect of an inferior-grade prefecture — all executive offices.

sentences.zh: 典軍為武，余並為文也。、

translations.literal: Martial directors are military; the rest are civil.
translations.idiomatic: Martial directors are military offices; the rest are civil.

sentences.zh: 朝請大夫文散官、開國男爵、遊擊將軍武散官、騎都尉勳官。

translations.literal: Gentleman Invited to Court — civil honorary rank. Founding Baron — noble rank. Roaming Strike General — military honorary rank. Commandant of Cavalry. Merit rank.
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman Invited to Court — a civil honorary rank. Founding Baron — a noble rank. Roaming Strike General — a military honorary rank. Commandant of Cavalry. A merit rank.

sentences.zh: 舊有太公廟令，武德年七品下，永徽二年加從五品上，開元二十四年省也。

translations.literal: Formerly there was a Director of the Grand Duke's Temple; in the Wude era, junior seventh rank, lower grade; in the second year of Yonghui raised to junior fifth rank, upper grade; abolished in the twenty-fourth year of Kaiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly there was a Director of the Grand Duke's Temple; in the Wude era it ranked junior seventh rank, lower grade; in the second year of Yonghui it was raised to junior fifth rank, upper grade; and it was abolished in the twenty-fourth year of Kaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 從第五品下階大理正、太常丞、太史令、內給事太子典內舊正六品上，《開元令》改、下都督府、上州司馬《武德令》，上州治中正五品下。

translations.literal: Junior fifth rank, lower grade — Directing Investigator of Judicial Review; Vice Director of Ceremonies; Director of the Astrological Service; Inner Provider and Heir Apparent Palace Storehouse Attendant, formerly senior sixth rank, upper grade, changed under the Kaiyuan Code; chief administrator of a lower protectorate; Vice Marshal of a superior-grade prefecture — under the Wude Code the superior-grade administrative aide ranked senior fifth rank, lower grade.
translations.idiomatic: Junior fifth rank, lower grade — Directing Investigator of Judicial Review; Vice Director of Ceremonies; Director of the Astrological Service; and Inner Provider and Heir Apparent Palace Storehouse Attendant, formerly senior sixth rank, upper grade and changed under the Kaiyuan Code; chief administrator of a lower protectorate; and Vice Marshal of a superior-grade prefecture — under the Wude Code the superior-grade administrative aide ranked senior fifth rank, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 貞觀初改、親王友《武德令》，正五品下也、宮苑總監、上牧監、上府果毅都尉已上職事官。

translations.literal: Changed at the beginning of Zhenguan. Friend to an Imperial Prince — under the Wude Code, senior fifth rank, lower grade. Chief Director of Palace Parks; Superior Stud Director; Resolute Army Commandant of a superior-grade prefecture — the above are executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: It was changed at the beginning of Zhenguan. Friend to an Imperial Prince — under the Wude Code, senior fifth rank, lower grade. Chief Director of Palace Parks; Superior Stud Director; and Resolute Army Commandant of a superior-grade prefecture — all executive offices.

sentences.zh: 果毅為武散，余並為文、駙馬都尉、奉車都尉並武散官。

translations.literal: Resolute Army commandants are military honorary; the rest are civil. Commandant of Cavalry Attendant and Commandant for Attending Carriages — both military honorary ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Resolute Army commandants are military honorary ranks; the rest are civil. Commandant of Cavalry Attendant and Commandant for Attending Carriages — both military honorary ranks.

sentences.zh: 駙馬自近代已來，唯尚公主者授之。

translations.literal: Since recent times, the Commandant of Cavalry Attendant has been conferred only on those who marry imperial princesses.
translations.idiomatic: Since recent times, the Commandant of Cavalry Attendant has been conferred only on men who marry imperial princesses.

sentences.zh: 奉車，有唐已來無其人、朝散大夫文散官、遊擊將軍武散官。

translations.literal: For Commandant for Attending Carriages, since the Tang dynasty there has been no appointee. Gentleman for Court Service — civil honorary rank. Roaming Strike General — military honorary rank.
translations.idiomatic: As for the Commandant for Attending Carriages, since the Tang dynasty there has been no appointee. Gentleman for Court Service — a civil honorary rank. Roaming Strike General — a military honorary rank.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》有天策上將府主簿、記室、參軍，九年省。

translations.literal: The Wude Code had Registrar, Recorder, and Adjutant of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief's Office; abolished in the ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: The Wude Code provided for a Registrar, Recorder, and Adjutant of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief's Office; all were abolished in the ninth year.

sentences.zh: 《神龍令》有庫谷、斜穀監也。

translations.literal: The Shenlong Code also provided for Superintendents of Kugu and Xiegu passes.
translations.idiomatic: The Shenlong Code also provided for Superintendents of the Kugu and Xiegu passes.

sentences.zh: 正第六品上階太學博士《武德令》，從六品上，貞觀年改、太子詹事府丞、太子司議郎、太子舍人、中郡長史《武德令》，中州別駕從五品上，貞觀年改也、太子典膳藥藏郎、京兆、河南、太原府諸縣令武德元年敕，雍州諸縣令階從五品上，七年定令改、親王府掾屬《武德令》，從五品下也、武庫中尚署令《武德令》依上署令，從七品下，太極年改武庫令階，開元年改中尚令階、諸衛左右司階、中府果毅都尉、鎮軍兵滿二萬人已上司馬已上職事官。

translations.literal: Senior sixth rank, upper grade — Erudite of the Imperial Academy: under the Wude Code, junior sixth rank, upper grade; changed in the Zhenguan era — Assistant of the Household of the Heir Apparent; Heir Apparent Discussion Gentleman; Heir Apparent Attendant; chief administrator of a middle-grade commandery — under the Wude Code the Vice Prefect of a middle-grade prefecture was junior fifth rank, upper grade; changed in the Zhenguan era — Heir Apparent Provision and Pharmacy Storehouse Attendant; magistrates of the various counties of the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures — Wude first-year edict: Yong prefecture county magistrates junior fifth rank, upper grade; changed by the seventh-year code — staff member of a princely establishment: under the Wude Code, junior fifth rank, lower grade — Armory Central Storehouse Director: under the Wude Code followed upper storehouse director, junior seventh rank, lower grade; Taizi era changed armory director rank; Kaiyuan era changed central storehouse director rank; left and right rank officers of the various guards; Army Boldness Commandant of a middle-grade prefecture; marshal of a garrison with twenty thousand troops or more — the above are executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: Senior sixth rank, upper grade — Erudite of the Imperial Academy ranked junior sixth rank, upper grade under the Wude Code and was changed in the Zhenguan era — Assistant of the Household of the Heir Apparent; Heir Apparent Discussion Gentleman; Heir Apparent Attendant; and chief administrator of a middle-grade commandery — under the Wude Code the Vice Prefect of a middle-grade prefecture ranked junior fifth rank, upper grade and was changed in the Zhenguan era — Heir Apparent Provision and Pharmacy Storehouse Attendant; magistrates of the various counties of the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures — a Wude first-year edict made Yong prefecture county magistrates junior fifth rank, upper grade, later changed by the seventh-year code — staff member of a princely establishment ranked junior fifth rank, lower grade under the Wude Code — Armory Central Storehouse Director followed the upper storehouse director at junior seventh rank, lower grade under the Wude Code; the armory director rank was changed in the Taizi era and the central storehouse director rank in the Kaiyuan era — left and right rank officers of the various guards; Army Boldness Commandant of a middle-grade prefecture; and marshal of a garrison with twenty thousand troops or more — all executive offices.

sentences.zh: 司階、果毅為武，余並為文也、親勳翊衛校衛衛官、朝議郎文散官、昭武校尉武散官、驍騎尉勳官正第六品下階千牛備身左右衛官已上、王公已下高品子孫起家為之、太子文學、下州長史武德中，下州別駕，正六品，貞觀二十三年，改為長史丞。

translations.literal: Rank officers and army-boldness commandants are military; the rest are civil — Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guard Company Commanders, guard officers; Gentleman for Court Discussion, civil honorary rank; Martial Proclaimer Company Commander, military honorary rank; Valiant Cavalry Commandant, merit rank. Senior sixth rank, lower grade — Thousand-Ox Bodyguards and above of the Left and Right Guards, entered by high-ranking descendants of princes and dukes downward — Heir Apparent Literary Instructor; chief administrator of a lower-grade prefecture: in Wude the Vice Prefect of a lower-grade prefecture was senior sixth rank; in the twenty-third year of Zhenguan changed to chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Rank officers and army-boldness commandants are military offices; the rest are civil — Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guard Company Commanders and guard officers; Gentleman for Court Discussion, a civil honorary rank; Martial Proclaimer Company Commander, a military honorary rank; and Valiant Cavalry Commandant, a merit rank. Senior sixth rank, lower grade — Thousand-Ox Bodyguards and above of the Left and Right Guards, posts entered by high-ranking descendants of princes and dukes downward — Heir Apparent Literary Instructor; and chief administrator of a lower-grade prefecture: in Wude the Vice Prefect of a lower-grade prefecture ranked senior sixth rank; in the twenty-third year of Zhenguan (649) the post became chief administrator.

sentences.zh: 永淳元年，諸州置別駕官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongchun, vice-prefect posts were established in all prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongchun (682), vice-prefect posts were established in all prefectures.

sentences.zh: 天寶八載停別駕，下郡置長史。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tianbao vice-prefects were suspended and chief administrators were placed in lower commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tianbao (749) vice-prefects were suspended and chief administrators were placed in lower commanderies.

sentences.zh: 後上元二年，諸州置別駕，不廢下府長史也、中州司馬《武德令》，中州治中，從五品下，《貞觀令》改、內謁者監、中牧監、上牧副監已上文職事官、上鎮將武職事官。

translations.literal: Later, in the second year of Shangyuan, vice-prefects were established in all prefectures without abolishing the chief administrators of lower prefectures — Vice Marshal of a middle-grade prefecture: under the Wude Code, middle-grade administrative aide, junior fifth rank, lower grade; changed by the Zhenguan Code — Inner Usher Director; middle pasture superintendent; deputy superintendent of a superior pasture — the above are civil executive offices; garrison general of a superior garrison — military executive office.
translations.idiomatic: Later, in the second year of Shangyuan (675), vice-prefects were established in all prefectures without abolishing the chief administrators of lower prefectures — Vice Marshal of a middle-grade prefecture ranked as middle-grade administrative aide, junior fifth rank, lower grade under the Wude Code and was changed under the Zhenguan Code — Inner Usher Director; middle pasture superintendent; and deputy superintendent of a superior pasture — all civil executive offices; and garrison general of a superior garrison — a military executive office.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》，從四品下也、承議郎文散官、昭武副尉武散官。

translations.literal: Under the Wude Code, junior fourth rank, lower grade — Gentleman for Supporting Discussion, civil honorary rank; Martial Proclaimer Deputy Commander, military honorary rank.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Wude Code it ranked junior fourth rank, lower grade — Gentleman for Supporting Discussion, a civil honorary rank; and Martial Proclaimer Deputy Commander, a military honorary rank.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》有天策上將府諸曹參軍事，九年省也。

translations.literal: The Wude Code had adjutants of the various bureaus of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief's Office; abolished in the ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: The Wude Code provided for adjutants of the various bureaus of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief's Office; the posts were abolished in the ninth year.

sentences.zh: 從第六品上階起居郎、起居舍人、尚書諸司員外郎《武德令》，吏部員外郎正六品上，諸司員外郎正六品下。

translations.literal: Junior sixth rank, upper grade — Court Diarist; Court Diarist Attendant; vice directors of the Department bureaus — under the Wude Code, the Personnel Bureau Vice Director was senior sixth rank, upper grade; other bureau vice directors, senior sixth rank, lower grade.
translations.idiomatic: Junior sixth rank, upper grade — Court Diarist; Court Diarist Attendant; and vice directors of the Department bureaus — under the Wude Code the Personnel Bureau Vice Director ranked senior sixth rank, upper grade and the other bureau vice directors ranked senior sixth rank, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 貞觀二年改、八寺丞、大理司直、國子助教《武德令》，從七品上、城門符寶郎、通事舍人、秘書郎《武德令》，正七品上、著作佐郎《武德令》，正七品上、侍御醫《武德》、《乾封令》，正七品上。

translations.literal: Changed in the second year of Zhenguan — Vice Directors of the Eight Directorates; Directing Investigator of Judicial Review; Assistant Instructor of the National University — under the Wude Code, junior seventh rank, upper grade — Gate Seal and Credential Attendant; Master of External Communications; Secretariat Clerk — under the Wude Code, senior seventh rank, upper grade — Compiler Assistant — under the Wude Code, senior seventh rank, upper grade — Attending Imperial Physician — under the Wude and Qianfeng codes, senior seventh rank, upper grade.
translations.idiomatic: Changed in the second year of Zhenguan (628) — Vice Directors of the Eight Directorates; Directing Investigator of Judicial Review; and Assistant Instructor of the National University ranked junior seventh rank, upper grade under the Wude Code — Gate Seal and Credential Attendant; Master of External Communications; and Secretariat Clerk ranked senior seventh rank, upper grade under the Wude Code — Compiler Assistant ranked senior seventh rank, upper grade under the Wude Code — and Attending Imperial Physician ranked senior seventh rank, upper grade under the Wude and Qianfeng codes.

sentences.zh: 《神龍令》，從六品下。

translations.literal: Under the Shenlong Code, junior sixth rank, lower grade.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Shenlong Code, it ranked junior sixth rank, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 開元改、諸衛羽林長史、兩京市署令武德四年進為從五品上，七年定令，復舊也、下州司馬《武德令》，中下州治中，正六品下、親王文學、主簿、記室、錄事參軍《武德令》，親王府文學已上，並正六品下也、諸州上縣令已上文職事官、諸率府左右司階武職事官、鎮軍兵不滿二萬人司馬文職事官、左右監門校尉、親勳翊衛旅帥衛官、奉議郎文散官、振威校尉武散官、飛騎尉勳官從第六品下階侍御史舊從七品上，《垂拱令改》、少府、將作、國子監丞、太子內直典設宮門郎、太公廟令、司農寺諸園苑監、沙苑監、下牧監、宮苑總監副、互市監、中牧副監已上文職事官、下府果毅都尉武職事官、親王府校尉衛官、通直郎文散官、振威副尉武散官正第七品上階四門博士、詹事司直、左右千牛衛長史、尚食尚藥直長、太子左右衛司禦清道率府長史、軍器監丞、諸州中縣令、京兆河南太原府司錄參軍事、大都督大都護府錄事參軍事、親王府諸曹參軍已上文職事官。

translations.literal: Changed in the Kaiyuan era — chief administrators of the various guards and Feathered Forest Army; market directors of the two capitals, raised to junior fifth rank, upper grade in the fourth year of Wude and restored by the seventh-year code; Vice Marshal of a lower-grade prefecture — under the Wude Code the middle- and lower-grade administrative aide ranked senior sixth rank, lower grade; Prince Literary Instructor, chief recorder, secretary, and recording adjutant — under the Wude Code princely literary instructors and above all ranked senior sixth rank, lower grade; magistrates of superior-grade prefectures and above as civil executive offices; left and right rank officers of the various rate offices as military executive offices; marshals of garrisons with fewer than twenty thousand troops as civil executive offices; Gate Guard company commanders; Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guard brigade commanders as guard officers; Gentleman for Supporting Discussion, civil honorary rank; Quelling Might company commander, military honorary rank; Valiant Cavalry Commandant, merit rank. Junior sixth rank, lower grade — Attending Censor, formerly junior seventh rank, upper grade, changed under the Chuigong Code; vice directors of the Palace Workshops, Construction, and National University; Heir Apparent Inner Direct, Provision, and Palace Gate Attendants; Grand Duke Temple Director; various garden and pasture superintendents of the Directorate of Agriculture; deputy garden superintendent; lower pasture superintendent; deputy market superintendent; and deputy middle pasture superintendent as civil executive offices; Army Boldness Commandant of a lower-grade prefecture as a military executive office; princely company commanders as guard officers; Master for Direct Discussion, civil honorary rank; Quelling Might deputy commander, military honorary rank. Senior seventh rank, upper grade — Erudite of the Four Gates; Direct Investigator of the Household of the Heir Apparent; chief administrators of the Left and Right Thousand-Ox Guards; chief stewards of Food and Medicine; chief administrators of the Heir Apparent Guards, Imperial Escort, Clear Way, and Rate Offices; Armory Directorate vice director; magistrates of middle-grade prefectures; record-keeping adjutants of the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures; record-keeping adjutants of great area commands and great protectorates; and adjutants of the various bureaus of princely establishments as civil executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaiyuan era these posts were revised — chief administrators of the various guards and the Feathered Forest Army; market directors of the two capitals, raised to junior fifth rank, upper grade in the fourth year of Wude (621) and later restored by the seventh-year code; Vice Marshal of a lower-grade prefecture, which under the Wude Code had been the middle- and lower-grade administrative aide at senior sixth rank, lower grade; princely literary instructor, chief recorder, secretary, and recording adjutant, all senior sixth rank, lower grade under the Wude Code; superior-grade prefectural magistrates and the civil offices listed through deputy middle pasture superintendent; lower-grade Army Boldness Commandant; princely company commanders; Master for Direct Discussion; and Quelling Might deputy commander. At junior sixth rank, lower grade came the Attending Censor, formerly junior seventh rank, upper grade until the Chuigong Code; then the senior seventh-rank, upper-grade group from Erudite of the Four Gates through princely bureau adjutants.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》，親王府功曹、倉曹、戶曹、兵曹參軍事，從五品下；

translations.literal: Under the Wude Code, the Merit, Granary, Household, and War Section Adjutants of princely establishments were junior fifth rank, lower grade;
translations.idiomatic: Under the Wude Code, the Merit, Granary, Household, and War Section Adjutants of princely establishments ranked junior fifth rank, lower grade;

sentences.zh: 騎曹、鎧曹、田曹、士曹、水曹參軍事等，七品下也、中鎮將武職事官。

translations.literal: the Cavalry, Armor, Field, Labor, and Water Section Adjutants and the like were seventh rank, lower grade. Middle Garrison General — military executive office.
translations.idiomatic: the Cavalry, Armor, Field, Labor, and Water Section Adjutants and the like ranked seventh rank, lower grade. Middle Garrison General — a military executive office.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》，從五品下、太子千牛、親勳翊衛隊正副隊正已上衛官、朝請郎文散官、致果校尉武散官、雲騎尉勳官正第七品下階尚衣尚舍尚乘尚輦直長、太子通事舍人、內寺伯、京兆河南太原府大都督大都護府諸曹參軍、中都督上都護府錄事參軍事、諸倉諸冶司竹溫湯監、諸衛左右中候、上府別將《武德令》，別將正五品上，後改為果毅。

translations.literal: Under the Wude Code, junior fifth rank, lower grade. Heir Apparent Thousand-Ox Guard; Squad Leaders and Deputy Squad Leaders of the Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guards — the above are guard officers. Gentleman Invited to Court — civil honorary rank. Achieving Fruit Commandant — military honorary rank. Commandant of Cloud Cavalry. Merit rank. Senior seventh rank lower grade. Senior Attendants of Robes, Lodgings, Transport, and Palanquins; Heir Apparent Master of External Communications; Inner Temple Majordomo; Section Adjutants of the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures, Great Area Commands, and Great Protectorates; Recording Adjutants of Middle Protectorates and Superior Protectorates; Superintendents of the various granaries, smelting works, bamboo groves, and hot springs; Left and Right Middle Inspectors of the various guards; Separate Commander of a superior-grade prefecture — under the Wude Code, separate commanders were senior fifth rank, upper grade; later changed to Resolute Army commandants.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Wude Code, it ranked junior fifth rank, lower grade. Heir Apparent Thousand-Ox Guard; Squad Leaders and Deputy Squad Leaders of the Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guards — all guard officers. Gentleman Invited to Court — a civil honorary rank. Achieving Fruit Commandant — a military honorary rank. Commandant of Cloud Cavalry. A merit rank. Senior seventh rank, lower grade. Senior Attendants of Robes, Lodgings, Transport, and Palanquins; Heir Apparent Master of External Communications; Inner Temple Majordomo; Section Adjutants of the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures, Great Area Commands, and Great Protectorates; Recording Adjutants of Middle Protectorates and Superior Protectorates; Superintendents of the various granaries, smelting works, bamboo groves, and hot springs; Left and Right Middle Inspectors of the various guards; and Separate Commander of a superior-grade prefecture — under the Wude Code, separate commanders ranked senior fifth rank, upper grade; later they were redesignated Resolute Army commandants.

sentences.zh: 聖曆三年復置別將、上府長史《武德令》，統軍長史正八品下也、上鎮副《武德令》，從五品下、下鎮將《武德令》，正六品下、下牧副監已上職事官。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shengli, separate commanders were restored. Chief Administrator of a superior-grade prefecture — under the Wude Code, the chief administrator of an army command was senior eighth rank, lower grade. Deputy of a superior garrison — under the Wude Code, junior fifth rank, lower grade. General of an inferior garrison — under the Wude Code, senior sixth rank, lower grade. Deputy Director of an inferior stud — the above are executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Shengli, separate commanders were restored. Chief Administrator of a superior-grade prefecture — under the Wude Code, the chief administrator of an army command ranked senior eighth rank, lower grade. Deputy of a superior garrison — under the Wude Code, junior fifth rank, lower grade. General of an inferior garrison — under the Wude Code, senior sixth rank, lower grade. Deputy Director of an inferior stud — all of the above are executive offices.

sentences.zh: 中候、別將、鎮副、鎮將為武，余並為文也、宣德郎文散官、致果副尉武散官。

translations.literal: Middle Inspectors, separate commanders, deputy garrison commanders, and garrison generals are military; the rest are civil. Gentleman for Promoting Virtue — civil honorary rank. Deputy Achieving Fruit Commandant. Military honorary rank.
translations.idiomatic: Middle Inspectors, separate commanders, deputy garrison commanders, and garrison generals are military posts; the rest are civil. Gentleman for Promoting Virtue — a civil honorary rank. Deputy Achieving Fruit Commandant. A military honorary rank.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》又有天策上將府參軍事，九年省。

translations.literal: The Wude Code also had a Section Adjutant of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief's Office; abolished in the ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: The Wude Code also provided for a Section Adjutant of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief's Office; the post was abolished in the ninth year.

sentences.zh: 又有鹽池鹽井監、諸王百司問事謁者。

translations.literal: There were also Salt Pond and Salt Well Supervisors and ushers who handled inquiries for the various offices of princes.
translations.idiomatic: There were also supervisors of salt ponds and salt wells, and ushers who handled inquiries for the various offices of imperial princes.

sentences.zh: 從第七品上階殿中侍御史《武德》至《乾封令》，並正八品上，垂拱年改、左右補闕、太常博士、太學助教《武德令》，從八品下也、門下錄事、中書主書、尚書都事、九寺主簿、太子詹事主簿、太子左右內率監門率府長史、太子侍醫、太子三寺丞、都水監丞、諸州中下縣令、親王府東西閣祭酒《武德令》，正六品下、京縣丞萬年、長安、河南、洛陽、奉先、會昌、太原、晉陽、下都督府上州錄事參軍、中都督上都護府諸曹參軍事、中府別將長史、中鎮副《武德令》，正六品下。

translations.literal: Junior seventh rank upper grade. Attending Palace Censor — under the Wude through Qianfeng codes, all senior eighth rank, upper grade; changed in the Chuigong era. Left and Right Supplements; Erudite of the Directorate of Ceremonies; Assistant Instructor of the National University — under the Wude Code, junior eighth rank, lower grade. Chancellery Recording Clerk; Secretariat Document Officer; Department Chief Clerk; Registrars of the Nine Courts; Registrar of the Heir Apparent's Household; Chief Administrators of the Heir Apparent's Left and Right Inner Rate and Gate Rate Offices; Heir Apparent Attending Physician; Vice Directors of the Heir Apparent's Three Directorates; Vice Director of the Waterways Directorate; Magistrates of middle-inferior-grade counties; Sacrificial Wine Masters of the East and West Pavilions of Princely Establishments — under the Wude Code, senior sixth rank, lower grade. Assistants of capital counties: Wan'nian, Chang'an, Henan, Luoyang, Fengxian, Huichang, Taiyuan, and Jinyang. Recording Adjutant of lower protectorates and superior prefectures; Section Adjutants of Middle Protectorates and Superior Protectorates; Chief Administrator of the Separate Commander of a middle-grade prefecture; Deputy of a middle garrison — under the Wude Code, senior sixth rank, lower grade.
translations.idiomatic: Junior seventh rank, upper grade. Attending Palace Censor — under the Wude through Qianfeng codes, all ranked senior eighth rank, upper grade; changed in the Chuigong era. Left and Right Supplements; Erudite of the Directorate of Ceremonies; and Assistant Instructor of the National University — under the Wude Code, junior eighth rank, lower grade. Chancellery Recording Clerk; Secretariat Document Officer; Department Chief Clerk; Registrars of the Nine Courts; Registrar of the Heir Apparent's Household; Chief Administrators of the Heir Apparent's Left and Right Inner Rate and Gate Rate Offices; Heir Apparent Attending Physician; Vice Directors of the Heir Apparent's Three Directorates; Vice Director of the Waterways Directorate; Magistrates of middle-inferior-grade counties; and Sacrificial Wine Masters of the East and West Pavilions of Princely Establishments — under the Wude Code, senior sixth rank, lower grade. Assistants of capital counties — Wan'nian, Chang'an, Henan, Luoyang, Fengxian, Huichang, Taiyuan, and Jinyang. Recording Adjutant of lower protectorates and superior prefectures; Section Adjutants of Middle Protectorates and Superior Protectorates; Chief Administrator of the Separate Commander of a middle-grade prefecture; and Deputy of a middle garrison — under the Wude Code, senior sixth rank, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 已上職事官。

translations.literal: The above are executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: All of the above are executive offices.

sentences.zh: 別將、鎮副為武，余並為文、左右監門直長勳衛、太子親衛已上衛官、朝散郎文散官、翊麾校尉武散官、武騎尉勳官從第七品下階太史丞監局同、御史台少府將作國子監主簿御史台、國子監主簿、舊正八品，《垂拱令》改、掖庭令、宮闈令、上署令郊社、太樂、鼓吹、太醫、太官、左藏令、乘黃、典客、上林、太倉、平准、常平、左尚、右尚、典牧。

translations.literal: Separate commanders and deputy garrison commanders are military; the rest are civil. Left and Right Gate Guard Senior Attendants; Merit Guards; Heir Apparent Personal Guards — the above are guard officers. Gentleman for Court Service — civil honorary rank. Assisting Banner Commandant — military honorary rank. Commandant of Martial Cavalry. Merit rank. Junior seventh rank lower grade. Assistant Grand Astrologer; same as the directorate offices. Registrars of the Censorate, Palace Workshops, Construction, and National University — formerly senior eighth rank; changed under the Chuigong Code. Director of the Rear Palace; Director of the Inner Palace; Directors of upper-grade offices: State Altars, Imperial Music, Musical Acclamation, Imperial Medicine, Imperial Kitchen, Left Treasury, Horse Breeding, Reception of Guests, Royal Park, Granary, Price Stabilization, Ever-Normal Granary, Left Atelier, Right Atelier, and Pasturage Administration.
translations.idiomatic: Separate commanders and deputy garrison commanders are military posts; the rest are civil. Left and Right Gate Guard Senior Attendants; Merit Guards; and Heir Apparent Personal Guards — all guard officers. Gentleman for Court Service — a civil honorary rank. Assisting Banner Commandant — a military honorary rank. Commandant of Martial Cavalry. A merit rank. Junior seventh rank, lower grade. Assistant Grand Astrologer — the same as the directorate offices. Registrars of the Censorate, Palace Workshops, Construction, and National University — formerly senior eighth rank; changed under the Chuigong Code. Director of the Rear Palace; Director of the Inner Palace; and Directors of upper-grade offices — State Altars, Imperial Music, Musical Acclamation, Imperial Medicine, Imperial Kitchen, Left Treasury, Horse Breeding, Reception of Guests, Royal Park, Granary, Price Stabilization, Ever-Normal Granary, Left Atelier, Right Atelier, and Pasturage Administration.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》有太廟、諸陵、典農、中尚、都水、常平。

translations.literal: The Wude Code also had Imperial Ancestral Temple, Imperial Tombs, Agricultural Administration, Middle Atelier, Waterways, and Ever-Normal Granary offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Wude Code also provided for Imperial Ancestral Temple, Imperial Tombs, Agricultural Administration, Middle Atelier, Waterways, and Ever-Normal Granary offices.

sentences.zh: 其左尚、典牧本中署，右尚本下署，開元初改之也、諸州下縣令天寶五載，一切為中下縣、諸陵署丞永徽二年加秩。

translations.literal: Left Atelier and Pasturage Administration were originally middle-grade offices; Right Atelier was originally a lower-grade office — changed at the beginning of Kaiyuan. Magistrates of inferior-grade counties — in the fifth year of Tianbao, all were redesignated as middle-inferior counties. Vice Directors of imperial tomb offices — rank raised in the second year of Yonghui.
translations.idiomatic: Left Atelier and Pasturage Administration had originally been middle-grade offices, and Right Atelier a lower-grade office — all were changed at the beginning of Kaiyuan. Magistrates of inferior-grade counties — in the fifth year of Tianbao, all such counties were redesignated middle-inferior. Vice Directors of imperial tomb offices — their rank was raised in the second year of Yonghui.

sentences.zh: 舊有太廟署丞，武德為九品，永徽二年加秩，從七品上，開元年省也、司農寺諸園苑副監《神龍令》有諸冶副監、宮苑總監丞，下都督府諸曹參軍，太子內坊丞舊正八品上，開元初改、親王國令舊規，流內正九品，太極年改、公主家令舊規，流內正八品，太極年改、上州諸參軍事、下府別將長史、下鎮副《武德令》，從六品下、諸屯監《武德令》有芳醖監，《神龍令》有漆園監、諸率府左右中候、鎮軍滿二萬人以上諸曹判司已上職事官。

translations.literal: Formerly there was a Grand Temple Agency deputy director, ninth rank in Wude, raised to junior seventh rank, upper grade in the second year of Yonghui and abolished in the Kaiyuan era; deputy superintendents of the various gardens of the Directorate of Agriculture — the Shendragon Code added deputy smeltery superintendents; deputy garden superintendent; adjutants of the various bureaus of lower protectorates; Heir Apparent Inner Bureau deputy director, formerly senior eighth rank, upper grade, changed at the beginning of Kaiyuan; Princely State Director under the old rule, within-sequence ninth rank, changed in the Taizi era; Princess Household Director under the old rule, within-sequence eighth rank, changed in the Taizi era; adjutants of superior-grade prefectures; chief administrator and separate commander of a lower-grade prefecture; deputy garrison general — under the Wude Code, junior sixth rank, lower grade; colony superintendents — the Wude Code had wine-fermentation superintendents, the Shendragon Code lacquer-garden superintendents; left and right middle ushers of the various rate offices; and clerical judges of garrisons with twenty thousand troops or more — the above are executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: There had formerly been a Grand Temple Agency deputy director, ninth rank in Wude, raised to junior seventh rank, upper grade in the second year of Yonghui (651) and abolished in the Kaiyuan era; deputy garden superintendents of the Directorate of Agriculture, with the Shendragon Code adding deputy smeltery superintendents; deputy garden superintendent; adjutants of lower protectorates; Heir Apparent Inner Bureau deputy director, formerly senior eighth rank, upper grade and changed at the beginning of Kaiyuan; princely state director and princess household director under older within-sequence rules later revised in the Taizi era; superior-grade prefectural adjutants; lower-grade separate commander and chief administrator; deputy garrison general at junior sixth rank, lower grade under the Wude Code; colony superintendents including wine-fermentation and lacquer-garden posts; left and right middle ushers of the rate offices; and clerical judges of garrisons with twenty thousand troops or more — all executive offices.

sentences.zh: 別將、鎮副、中候為武，余並為文也、太子左右監門直長、親王府旅帥、諸折沖府校尉已上衛官。

translations.literal: Separate commanders, deputy garrison commanders, and middle inspectors are military; the rest are civil. Left and Right Gate Guard Senior Attendants of the Heir Apparent; Brigade Commander of Princely Establishments; Captains of the various Army-Suppressing prefectures — the above are guard officers.
translations.idiomatic: Separate commanders, deputy garrison commanders, and middle inspectors are military posts; the rest are civil. Left and Right Gate Guard Senior Attendants of the Heir Apparent; Brigade Commander of Princely Establishments; and Captains of the various Army-Suppressing prefectures — all guard officers.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》，諸府校尉，正六品下也、宣議郎文散官、翊麾副尉武散官正第八品上階監察御史舊從八品上，《垂拱令》改、協律郎、諸衛羽林龍武軍錄事參軍事、中署令鉤盾、右藏、職染、掌治，《武德令》有衣冠署令、中州錄事參軍事、太醫博士、太子典膳藥藏丞、軍器監主簿、武庫署丞舊從八品下，開元初改、兩京市署丞、上牧監丞《武德令》，從八品下，《神龍令》有庫谷、斜谷、太陰、伊陽監丞、鎮軍不滿二萬人以上諸曹判司已上文職事官、翊衛、太子勳衛、親王府執仗執乘親事已上衛官、給事郎文散官、宣節校尉武散官。

translations.literal: Under the Wude Code, captains of the various prefectures ranked senior sixth rank, lower grade. Gentleman for Proclaiming Righteousness — civil honorary rank. Deputy Assisting Banner Commandant. Military honorary rank. Senior eighth rank upper grade. Investigating Censor — formerly junior eighth rank, upper grade; changed under the Chuigong Code. Pitch-Harmonizing Gentleman; Recording Adjutants of the various guards, Forest of Feathers, and Dragon Martial Army; Directors of middle-grade offices: Arsenal Shields, Right Treasury, Dyeing, and Foundry — the Wude Code also had Directors of the Robes and Caps Office. Recording Adjutant of a middle-grade prefecture; Erudite of Imperial Medicine; Vice Directors of the Heir Apparent's Provisions and Medicine Storehouses; Registrar of the Armory Directorate; Assistant of the Armory Office — formerly junior eighth rank, lower grade; changed at the beginning of Kaiyuan. Assistants of the market offices of the two capitals; Assistants of superior stud directorates — under the Wude Code, junior eighth rank, lower grade; the Shenlong Code had assistants of the Kugu, Xiegu, and Taiyin-Yiyang stud offices. Bureau Reviewers of Garrison Armies with fewer than twenty thousand troops — the above are civil executive offices. Assisting Guards; Heir Apparent Merit Guards; Staff Bearers, Carriage Attendants, and Personal Attendants of Princely Establishments, (the above are guard officers. Gentleman Attendant — civil honorary rank. Proclaiming Festival Commandant. Military honorary rank.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Wude Code, captains of the various prefectures ranked senior sixth rank, lower grade. Gentleman for Proclaiming Righteousness — a civil honorary rank. Deputy Assisting Banner Commandant. A military honorary rank. Senior eighth rank, upper grade. Investigating Censor — formerly junior eighth rank, upper grade; changed under the Chuigong Code. Pitch-Harmonizing Gentleman; Recording Adjutants of the various guards, Forest of Feathers, and Dragon Martial Army; and Directors of middle-grade offices — Arsenal Shields, Right Treasury, Dyeing, and Foundry — the Wude Code also provided for Directors of the Robes and Caps Office. Recording Adjutant of a middle-grade prefecture; Erudite of Imperial Medicine; Vice Directors of the Heir Apparent's Provisions and Medicine Storehouses; Registrar of the Armory Directorate; and Assistant of the Armory Office — formerly junior eighth rank, lower grade; all were changed at the beginning of Kaiyuan. Assistants of the market offices of the two capitals and of superior stud directorates — under the Wude Code, junior eighth rank, lower grade; the Shenlong Code also provided assistants for the Kugu, Xiegu, and Taiyin-Yiyang stud offices. Bureau Reviewers of Garrison Armies with fewer than twenty thousand troops — all of the above are civil executive offices. Assisting Guards; Heir Apparent Merit Guards; and Staff Bearers, Carriage Attendants, and Personal Attendants of Princely Establishments, (all of the above are guard officers. Gentleman Attendant — a civil honorary rank. Proclaiming Festival Commandant. A military honorary rank.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》有天策上將府典簽，九年省。

translations.literal: The Wude Code had a Credential Officer of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief's Office; abolished in the ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: The Wude Code provided for a Credential Officer of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief's Office; the post was abolished in the ninth year.

sentences.zh: 正第八品下階奚官內僕內府局令、下署令太卜、廩犧、珍羞、良醖、掌醢、守宮、武器、車府、司儀、崇玄、導官、中右校、左校、甄官、河渠、弩坊、甲坊。

translations.literal: Senior eighth rank lower grade. Directors of the Palace Women, Inner Servants, and Inner Treasury Bureaus; Directors of lower-grade offices: Grand Divination, Sacrificial Animals, Rare Delicacies, Fine Brew, Pickled Meats, Palace Maintenance, Weapons, Carriage Office, Ceremonial Conduct, Daoist Studies, Guiding Officer, Middle and Right Workshops, Left Workshop, Ceramics, River Works, Crossbow Workshop, and Armor Workshop.
translations.idiomatic: Senior eighth rank, lower grade. Directors of the Palace Women, Inner Servants, and Inner Treasury Bureaus; and Directors of lower-grade offices — Grand Divination, Sacrificial Animals, Rare Delicacies, Fine Brew, Pickled Meats, Palace Maintenance, Weapons, Carriage Office, Ceremonial Conduct, Daoist Studies, Guiding Officer, Middle and Right Workshops, Left Workshop, Ceramics, River Works, Crossbow Workshop, and Armor Workshop.

sentences.zh: 《神龍令》又有幹、楫二署令也、諸衛羽林龍武諸曹參軍事、中州諸司參軍事、親王府京兆河南太原府大都督大都護府參軍事《武德令》，親王府參軍，從七品下，雍州行參軍，正八品上、尚藥局司醫、京兆河南太原府諸縣丞、太子內直宮門丞、太公廟丞、諸宮農圃監、互市監丞、司竹副監、司農寺諸園苑監丞、靈台郎已上文職事官、諸衛左右司戈、上戍主已上武職事官。

translations.literal: The Shenlong Code also had Directors of the Oar and Paddle offices. Section Adjutants of the various guards, Forest of Feathers, and Dragon Martial Army; Bureau Adjutants of middle-grade prefectures; Section Adjutants of Princely Establishments and the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures, Great Area Commands, and Great Protectorates — under the Wude Code, section adjutants of princely establishments ranked junior seventh rank, lower grade; acting adjutants of Yong Prefecture ranked senior eighth rank, upper grade. Palace Medicine Bureau Physicians; Assistants of counties in the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures; Vice Directors of the Heir Apparent's Inner Attendant and Palace Gate offices; Assistant of the Grand Duke's Temple; Directors of palace farms and gardens; Assistants of border-trade superintendents; Deputy Superintendent of bamboo groves; Assistants of garden directors under the Ministry of Agriculture; Spirit Terrace Gentleman — the above are civil executive offices. Left and Right Guards-with-Halberds of the various guards; Chiefs of superior garrison posts — the above are military executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Shenlong Code also provided for Directors of the Oar and Paddle offices. Section Adjutants of the various guards, Forest of Feathers, and Dragon Martial Army; Bureau Adjutants of middle-grade prefectures; and Section Adjutants of Princely Establishments and the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures, Great Area Commands, and Great Protectorates — under the Wude Code, section adjutants of princely establishments ranked junior seventh rank, lower grade, while acting adjutants of Yong Prefecture ranked senior eighth rank, upper grade. Palace Medicine Bureau Physicians; Assistants of counties in the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures; Vice Directors of the Heir Apparent's Inner Attendant and Palace Gate offices; Assistant of the Grand Duke's Temple; Directors of palace farms and gardens; Assistants of border-trade superintendents; Deputy Superintendent of bamboo groves; Assistants of garden directors under the Ministry of Agriculture; and Spirit Terrace Gentleman — all civil executive offices. Left and Right Guards-with-Halberds of the various guards and Chiefs of superior garrison posts — all military executive offices.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》有中鎮長史、備身衛官、征事郎文散官、宣節副尉武散官從第八品上階左右拾遣、太醫署針博士、四門助教《武德令》，從九品上、左右千牛衛錄事參軍、下州錄事參軍《武德令》有中下州諸司參軍事、諸州上縣丞、中牧監丞《武德令》，正八品上、京縣主簿、太子左右衛司禦清道率府錄事參軍、中都督府上都護府參軍、親王府行參軍《武德令》，正八品上、京兆河南太原大都督府博士《武德令》，雍州博士，從八品下、諸倉諸冶司竹溫湯監丞《武德令》有鹽池、鹽井監丞，《神龍令》有太和監丞、保章正已上文職事官、太子翊衛諸府旅帥已上衛官。

translations.literal: Under the Wude Code there was a middle-garrison chief administrator; bodyguard guard officers; Gentleman for Campaign Affairs, civil honorary rank; Festival Proclaimer deputy commander, military honorary rank. Junior eighth rank, upper grade — Left and Right Reminder; acupuncture erudite of the Medical Service; Assistant Instructor of the Four Gates — under the Wude Code, junior ninth rank, upper grade; recording adjutants of the Left and Right Thousand-Ox Guards; recording adjutant of a lower-grade prefecture — under the Wude Code there were adjutants of the various bureaus of middle- and lower-grade prefectures; magistrates of superior-grade prefectural counties; deputy director of a middle pasture superintendent — under the Wude Code, senior eighth rank, upper grade; chief clerk of capital counties; recording adjutants of the Heir Apparent Guards, Imperial Escort, Clear Way, and Rate Offices; adjutants of middle protectorates and superior protectorates; princely traveling adjutant — under the Wude Code, senior eighth rank, upper grade; erudites of the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan great area commands — under the Wude Code the Yong prefecture erudite ranked junior eighth rank, lower grade; deputies of the various granaries, smelteries, bamboo offices, and hot-spring superintendents — the Wude Code had salt-pond and salt-well supervisor deputies, the Shendragon Code Taihe supervisor deputies; Court Astrologer — the above are civil executive offices; Heir Apparent Assisting Guard and brigade commanders of the various offices — the above are guard officers.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Wude Code there was a middle-garrison chief administrator, together with bodyguard officers, Gentleman for Campaign Affairs, and Festival Proclaimer deputy commander. Junior eighth rank, upper grade — Left and Right Reminder; acupuncture erudite of the Medical Service; and Assistant Instructor of the Four Gates, which under the Wude Code ranked junior ninth rank, upper grade; recording adjutants of the Left and Right Thousand-Ox Guards and of lower-grade prefectures; adjutants of middle- and lower-grade prefectural bureaus; superior-grade county magistrates; deputy middle pasture superintendent at senior eighth rank, upper grade under the Wude Code; capital county chief clerks; Heir Apparent guard and rate recording adjutants; middle and superior protectorate adjutants; princely traveling adjutants; great-area erudites; granary and smeltery deputies including salt-pond and Taihe supervisors; Court Astrologer; and Heir Apparent Assisting Guard and brigade commanders.

sentences.zh: 《武德》、《乾封令》，諸府旅帥，正七品下、承奉郎文散官、禦侮校尉武散官從第八品下階大理評事、律學博士、太醫署丞、醫監、太子左右春坊錄事、左右千牛衛諸曹參軍、內謁者、太子左右衛司禦清道率府諸曹參軍事、太子諸署令、掖庭宮圍局丞、太史都水監主簿太史為局則省主簿、中書門下尚書都省兵吏部考功禮部主事舊從九品上，開元二十四年改七司入八品，其省內諸司依舊、上署丞《武德令》有芳醖監丞、下都督府上州參軍事、中都督府上州博士、諸州中縣丞、諸王府典簽《武德令》，正八品下、京縣尉、親王國大司農舊規，流內正第七品，開元初改、公主家丞舊規，流內正第九品，開元初改、諸屯監丞、上關令、上府兵曹、上鎮倉曹兵曹參軍事《武德令》有下鎮長史、挈壺正已上文職事官、中戍主、上戌副、率府左右司戈已上武職事官、太子備身、親王府隊正已上衛官、承務郎文散官、禦侮副尉武散官正第九品上階校書郎《永徽令》加入從八品下，《垂拱令》復舊、太祝、太子左右內率監門府錄事參軍、太子內方典直、中署丞、典客署掌客、親勳翊衛府羽林兵曹參軍事、嶽瀆令、諸津令、下牧監丞《武德令》，正八品下。

translations.literal: Under the Wude and Qianfeng codes, brigade commanders of the various offices ranked senior seventh rank, lower grade; Gentleman for Receiving Service, civil honorary rank; Defender Against Insult company commander, military honorary rank. Junior eighth rank, lower grade — Judicial Review evaluator; erudite of the Law School; deputy director of the Medical Service; medical supervisor; recording clerks of the Heir Apparent Left and Right Spring Palaces; adjutants of the various bureaus of the Left and Right Thousand-Ox Guards; inner usher; adjutants of the various bureaus of the Heir Apparent Guards, Imperial Escort, Clear Way, and Rate Offices; directors of the Heir Apparent various agencies; deputy directors of the Palace Women and Inner Enclosure Bureaus; chief clerks of the Astrological Service and Waterways Directorate — when the Astrological Service became a bureau its chief clerk was abolished; section masters of the Secretariat, Chancellery, Department of State Affairs, Ministry of War, Ministry of Personnel, Bureau of Merit Review, and Ministry of Rites, formerly junior ninth rank, upper grade, with seven offices moved to eighth rank in the twenty-fourth year of Kaiyuan while the other directorate offices remained unchanged; deputy directors of upper agencies — the Wude Code had wine-fermentation supervisor deputies; adjutants of lower protectorates and superior prefectures; erudites of middle protectorates and superior prefectures; magistrates of middle-grade prefectural counties; princely credential keepers — under the Wude Code, senior eighth rank, lower grade; capital county captains; Grand Steward of a Princely State under the old rule, within-sequence seventh rank, changed at the beginning of Kaiyuan; princess household deputy director under the old rule, within-sequence ninth rank, changed at the beginning of Kaiyuan; colony supervisor deputies; directors of upper passes; military bureau adjutants of upper prefectures; granary and military bureau adjutants of upper garrisons — under the Wude Code there was a lower-garrison chief administrator; clepsydra keeper — the above are civil executive offices; middle garrison commanders, upper garrison deputies, and left and right rank guards of the rate offices — the above are military executive offices; Heir Apparent bodyguards and princely squad leaders — the above are guard officers; Gentleman for Receiving Duties, civil honorary rank; Defender Against Insult deputy commander, military honorary rank. Senior ninth rank, upper grade — proofreader — added to junior eighth rank, lower grade under the Yonghui Code and restored under the Chuigong Code; grand invocator; recording adjutants of the Heir Apparent Inner and Gate Rate Offices; Heir Apparent Inner Bureau attendants; deputy directors of middle agencies; guest reception attendants of the Guests Agency; Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guard and Feathered Forest military bureau adjutants; directors of sacred mountains and rivers; directors of ferries; deputy directors of lower pasture superintendents — under the Wude Code, senior eighth rank, lower grade.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Wude and Qianfeng codes, office brigade commanders ranked senior seventh rank, lower grade, together with Gentleman for Receiving Service and Defender Against Insult company commander. At junior eighth rank, lower grade came judicial review evaluators through princess household deputies, including the Kaiyuan-era reassignment of seven ministry section masters; then civil posts through clepsydra keeper; military posts through rate-office rank guards; guard posts through princely squad leaders; Gentleman for Receiving Duties and Defender Against Insult deputy commander; and the senior ninth-rank, upper-grade group from proofreader through lower pasture superintendent deputies.

sentences.zh: 《神龍令》有漆園丞，《開元前令》有沙苑丞、諸州中下丞、中郡博士《武德令》，正九品下、京兆河南太原府諸縣主簿、武庫署監事已上並文職事官。

translations.literal: The Shenlong Code had Lacquer Garden Assistants; the pre-Kaiyuan Code had Sha Plain Assistants. Assistants of middle-inferior-grade prefectures and counties; Erudites of middle commanderies — under the Wude Code, senior ninth rank, lower grade. Registrars of the counties of the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures; Overseer of the Armory Office — the above are civil executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Shenlong Code provided for Lacquer Garden Assistants, and the pre-Kaiyuan Code for Sha Plain Assistants. Assistants of middle-inferior-grade prefectures and counties and Erudites of middle commanderies — under the Wude Code, senior ninth rank, lower grade. Registrars of the counties of the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures and Overseer of the Armory Office — all civil executive offices.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》有天策上將府錄事。

translations.literal: The Wude Code had a Recording Clerk of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief's Office.
translations.idiomatic: The Wude Code provided for a Recording Clerk of the Celestial-Strategy General-in-Chief's Office.

sentences.zh: 其武庫監事，從九品下，太極年改也、儒林郎文散官、仁勇校尉武散官正第九品下階正字《永徽令》改入上階，《垂拱令》復舊、太子校書《永徽令》改入上階、《垂拱令》復舊、奚官內僕內府局丞、下署丞、尚食局食醫、尚藥局醫佐、尚乘局奉乘司庫司廩、太史局司辰、典廄署主乘、太子左右內率監門率府諸曹參軍事、太子三寺主簿、詹事府錄事龍朔年置桂坊錄事，咸亨年省、太子親勳翊府兵曹參軍事、諸州下縣丞、諸州上縣中縣主簿、中州參軍事《武德令》，正九品上、下州博士《武德令》，中下州博士，從九品上，下州博士，從九品下、京兆河南太原府諸縣尉、上牧主簿、諸宮農圃監丞、中關令、中府兵曹、親王國尉舊規，流內正八品，開元初改。

translations.literal: The Armory Office Overseer ranked junior ninth rank, lower grade — changed in the Taichi era. Gentleman of the Forest of Learning — civil honorary rank. Humane Courage Commandant. Military honorary rank. Senior ninth rank lower grade. Orthography Gentleman — under the Yonghui Code, moved to the upper grade; under the Chuigong Code, restored to former status. Heir Apparent Collator — under the Yonghui Code, moved to the upper grade; under the Chuigong Code, restored to former status. Assistants of the Palace Women, Inner Servants, and Inner Treasury Bureaus; Assistants of lower-grade offices; Dietary Physician of the Food Bureau; Medical Assistant of the Medicine Bureau; Offering Carriage Attendant and Stores and Granary Clerks of the Transport Bureau; Timekeeper of the Grand Astrologer's Office; Chief Carriage Attendant of the Stud Office; Section Adjutants of the Heir Apparent's Left and Right Inner Rate and Gate Rate Offices; Registrars of the Heir Apparent's Three Directorates; Recording Clerk of the Household Administration; Recording Clerk of the Cassia Ward, established in the Longshuo era, abolished in the Xianheng era. War Section Adjutant of the Heir Apparent's Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guard Office; Assistants of lower-grade counties; Registrars of upper- and middle-grade counties; Section Adjutants of middle-grade prefectures — under the Wude Code, senior ninth rank, upper grade. Erudites of lower-grade prefectures — under the Wude Code, erudites of middle-inferior-grade prefectures ranked junior ninth rank, upper grade, and erudites of lower-grade prefectures, junior ninth rank, lower grade. Wardens of the counties of the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures; Registrars of superior studs; Assistants of palace farm and garden directorates; Directors of middle passes; War Section Adjutants of middle-grade prefectures; Marshals of princely fiefs — formerly outside the regular ranks at senior eighth rank; changed at the beginning of Kaiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Armory Office Overseer ranked junior ninth rank, lower grade — changed in the Taichi era. Gentleman of the Forest of Learning — a civil honorary rank. Humane Courage Commandant. A military honorary rank. Senior ninth rank, lower grade. Orthography Gentleman — under the Yonghui Code, moved to the upper grade; under the Chuigong Code, restored to former status. Heir Apparent Collator — under the Yonghui Code, moved to the upper grade; under the Chuigong Code, restored to former status. Assistants of the Palace Women, Inner Servants, and Inner Treasury Bureaus; Assistants of lower-grade offices; Dietary Physician of the Food Bureau; Medical Assistant of the Medicine Bureau; Offering Carriage Attendant and Stores and Granary Clerks of the Transport Bureau; Timekeeper of the Grand Astrologer's Office; Chief Carriage Attendant of the Stud Office; Section Adjutants of the Heir Apparent's Left and Right Inner Rate and Gate Rate Offices; Registrars of the Heir Apparent's Three Directorates; Recording Clerk of the Household Administration; and Recording Clerk of the Cassia Ward, established in the Longshuo era and abolished in the Xianheng era. War Section Adjutant of the Heir Apparent's Personal, Merit, and Assisting Guard Office; Assistants of lower-grade counties; Registrars of upper- and middle-grade counties; and Section Adjutants of middle-grade prefectures — under the Wude Code, senior ninth rank, upper grade. Erudites of lower-grade prefectures — under the Wude Code, erudites of middle-inferior-grade prefectures ranked junior ninth rank, upper grade, and erudites of lower-grade prefectures ranked junior ninth rank, lower grade. Wardens of the counties of the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures; Registrars of superior studs; Assistants of palace farm and garden directorates; Directors of middle passes; War Section Adjutants of middle-grade prefectures; and Marshals of princely fiefs — formerly outside the regular ranks at senior eighth rank; all were changed at the beginning of Kaiyuan.

sentences.zh: 《武德令》有親王府鎮事及司閣、上關丞《武德令》有上津尉、諸衛左右執戟、中鎮兵曹參軍、下戍主已上職事官。

translations.literal: The Wude Code had Keepers of Princely Establishments and Gate Attendants. Assistants of major passes — the Wude Code had Wardens of major fords. Left and Right Guards-with-Halberds of the various guards; War Section Adjutant of a middle garrison; Chief of an inferior garrison post — the above are executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Wude Code provided for Keepers of Princely Establishments and Gate Attendants. Assistants of major passes — the Wude Code also provided for Wardens of major fords. Left and Right Guards-with-Halberds of the various guards; War Section Adjutant of a middle garrison; and Chief of an inferior garrison post — all executive offices.

sentences.zh: 執戟、戍主為武，余並為文、諸折沖府隊正衛官、登仕郎文散官、仁勇副尉武散官從第九品上階尚書諸司御史台秘書省殿中省主事、奉禮郎、律學助教、太子正字、弘文館校書、太史司曆、太醫署醫助教、京兆河南太原府九寺少府將作監錄事、都督都護府上州錄事市令、宮匹總監主簿、中牧監主簿《永徽令》有監漕、諸州中下縣主簿、上縣中縣尉、下府兵曹已上並職事文官、文林郎文散官、陪戎校尉武散官從第九品下階內侍省主事、國子監親王府錄事、太子左右春坊主事、崇文館校書、書學博士、算學博士、門下典儀、太醫署按摩咒禁博士、太卜署博士、太醫署針助教、太醫署醫正、太卜署卜正、太史局監候、親王國丞舊規，流內正第九品，開元初改從正流內、掖庭局宮教博士、太子諸署丞、太子典食署丞、太子廄牧署典乘、諸監作諸監事計官、太官署監膳、太樂鼓吹署樂正、大理寺獄丞、下州參軍事《武德令》，中下州行參軍，正九品，下州參軍，從九品上、中州下州醫博士、諸州中縣下縣尉、京縣錄事、下牧監主簿、下關令、中關丞、諸衛羽林長上、公主邑司錄事、諸津丞、下鎮兵曹參軍《武德令》有諸橋諸堰丞、諸率府左右執戟已上職事官。

translations.literal: Guards-with-Halberds and garrison chiefs are military; the rest are civil. Squad Leaders of the various Army-Suppressing prefectures — guard officers. Gentleman for Entering Office — civil honorary rank. Deputy Humane Courage Commandant. Military honorary rank. Junior ninth rank upper grade. Section Masters of the Department bureaus, Censorate, Palace Secretariat, and Palace Administration; Ceremonial Attendants; Assistant Erudite of the Law Academy; Heir Apparent Orthography Gentleman; Collators of the Hongwen Pavilion; Calendar Officer of the Grand Astrologer; Assistant Erudite of Imperial Medicine; Recording Clerks of the Nine Courts, Palace Workshops, and Construction Directorate in the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures; Recording Clerks and Market Directors of area commands, protectorates, and superior prefectures; Registrar of the Palace Textiles Chief Directorate; Registrar of a middle stud directorate — the Yonghui Code also provided for superintendents of grain transport. Registrars of middle-inferior-grade counties; Wardens of upper- and middle-grade counties; War Section Adjutants of lower-grade prefectures — the above are civil executive offices. Gentleman of Literary Elegance — civil honorary rank. Escorting Arms Commandant. Military honorary rank. Junior ninth rank lower grade. Section Master of the Inner Palace Service; Recording Clerk of the National University and Princely Establishments; Section Masters of the Heir Apparent's Left and Right Spring Pavilions; Collators of the Chongwen Pavilion; Erudites of the Calligraphy and Mathematics Academies; Ceremonial Officer of the Chancellery; Erudites of Massage, Spell-Charming Prohibition, Divination, and Acupuncture in the Imperial Medicine and Grand Divination Offices; Chief Physician and Divination Master; Observer of the Grand Astrologer's Office; Assistant of princely fiefs — formerly outside the regular ranks at senior ninth rank; at the beginning of Kaiyuan changed to within the regular senior ranks. Erudite Instructor of the Rear Palace; Vice Directors of the Heir Apparent's various offices; Vice Director of the Heir Apparent's Provisions Office; Chief Carriage Attendant of the Heir Apparent's Stud and Pasturage Office; Planning Officers of the various Construction and Oversight Offices; Superintendent of Provisions of the Imperial Kitchen; Music Master of the Musical Acclamation Office; Prison Assistant of the Court of Judicial Review; Section Adjutants of lower-grade prefectures — under the Wude Code, acting section adjutants of middle-inferior-grade prefectures ranked senior ninth rank, and section adjutants of lower-grade prefectures, junior ninth rank, upper grade. Erudites of Medicine of middle- and lower-grade prefectures; Wardens of middle- and lower-grade counties; Recording Clerks of capital counties; Registrars of inferior stud directorates; Directors of inferior passes; Assistants of middle passes; Senior Attendants of the various guards and Forest of Feathers; Recording Clerks of princess estate administrations; Assistants of fords; War Section Adjutants of inferior garrisons — the Wude Code also provided for assistants of various bridges and weirs. Left and Right Guards-with-Halberds of the various rate offices — the above are executive offices.
translations.idiomatic: Guards-with-Halberds and garrison chiefs are military posts; the rest are civil. Squad Leaders of the various Army-Suppressing prefectures — guard officers. Gentleman for Entering Office — a civil honorary rank. Deputy Humane Courage Commandant. A military honorary rank. Junior ninth rank, upper grade. Section Masters of the Department bureaus, Censorate, Palace Secretariat, and Palace Administration; Ceremonial Attendants; Assistant Erudite of the Law Academy; Heir Apparent Orthography Gentleman; Collators of the Hongwen Pavilion; Calendar Officer of the Grand Astrologer; Assistant Erudite of Imperial Medicine; Recording Clerks of the Nine Courts, Palace Workshops, and Construction Directorate in the Capital, Henan, and Taiyuan prefectures; Recording Clerks and Market Directors of area commands, protectorates, and superior prefectures; Registrar of the Palace Textiles Chief Directorate; and Registrar of a middle stud directorate — the Yonghui Code also provided for superintendents of grain transport. Registrars of middle-inferior-grade counties; Wardens of upper- and middle-grade counties; and War Section Adjutants of lower-grade prefectures — all civil executive offices. Gentleman of Literary Elegance — a civil honorary rank. Escorting Arms Commandant. A military honorary rank. Junior ninth rank, lower grade. Section Master of the Inner Palace Service; Recording Clerk of the National University and Princely Establishments; Section Masters of the Heir Apparent's Left and Right Spring Pavilions; Collators of the Chongwen Pavilion; Erudites of the Calligraphy and Mathematics Academies; Ceremonial Officer of the Chancellery; Erudites of Massage, Spell-Charming Prohibition, Divination, and Acupuncture in the Imperial Medicine and Grand Divination Offices; Chief Physician and Divination Master; Observer of the Grand Astrologer's Office; and Assistant of princely fiefs — formerly outside the regular ranks at senior ninth rank; at the beginning of Kaiyuan all were placed within the regular senior ranks. Erudite Instructor of the Rear Palace; Vice Directors of the Heir Apparent's various offices; Vice Director of the Heir Apparent's Provisions Office; Chief Carriage Attendant of the Heir Apparent's Stud and Pasturage Office; Planning Officers of the various Construction and Oversight Offices; Superintendent of Provisions of the Imperial Kitchen; Music Master of the Musical Acclamation Office; Prison Assistant of the Court of Judicial Review; and Section Adjutants of lower-grade prefectures — under the Wude Code, acting section adjutants of middle-inferior-grade prefectures ranked senior ninth rank, and section adjutants of lower-grade prefectures ranked junior ninth rank, upper grade. Erudites of Medicine of middle- and lower-grade prefectures; Wardens of middle- and lower-grade counties; Recording Clerks of capital counties; Registrars of inferior stud directorates; Directors of inferior passes; Assistants of middle passes; Senior Attendants of the various guards and Forest of Feathers; Recording Clerks of princess estate administrations; Assistants of fords; and War Section Adjutants of inferior garrisons — the Wude Code also provided for assistants of various bridges and weirs. Left and Right Guards-with-Halberds of the various rate offices — all executive offices.

sentences.zh: 長上、執戟為武，余並為文、親王府隊副、諸折沖府隊副已上衛官、將仕郎文散官、陪戎副尉武散官流內九品三十階之內，又有視流內起居，五品至從九品。

translations.literal: Senior Attendants and Guards-with-Halberds are military; the rest are civil. Deputy Squad Leaders of Princely Establishments; Deputy Squad Leaders of the various Army-Suppressing prefectures — guard officers. Gentleman Awaiting Office — civil honorary rank. Deputy Escorting Arms Commandant. Military honorary rank. Within the thirty grades of the nine ranks inside the regular sequence, there were also quasi-regular Court Diary attendants, from fifth rank down to junior ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: Senior Attendants and Guards-with-Halberds are military posts; the rest are civil. Deputy Squad Leaders of Princely Establishments and Deputy Squad Leaders of the various Army-Suppressing prefectures — all guard officers. Gentleman Awaiting Office — a civil honorary rank. Deputy Escorting Arms Commandant. A military honorary rank. Within the thirty grades of the nine ranks in the regular sequence, there were also quasi-regular Court Diary attendants, ranging from the fifth rank down to the junior ninth.

sentences.zh: 初以薩寶府、親王國官及三師、三公、開府、嗣郡王、上柱國已下護軍勳官帶職事者府官等品。

translations.literal: At first, grades were assigned to the Sogdian Treasury Office, prince fief officials, and the Three Preceptors, Three Dukes, open-the-feudal-office, heir-apparent kings, commandery kings, upper pillar of the state and below, protectors of the army, merit officers, and mansion officials of those bearing substantive posts.
translations.idiomatic: At first these grades applied to the Sogdian treasury office, prince fief officials, and the ranks of the three preceptors, three dukes, open-the-feudal-office holders, heir-apparent and commandery kings, merit officers from upper pillar of the state down through protector of the army, and the mansion officials of men who held substantive posts.

sentences.zh: 開元初，一切罷之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaiyuan, all were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Kaiyuan era, all of these were abolished.

sentences.zh: 今唯有薩寶、祅正二官而已。

translations.literal: Now only the two offices of Sogdian Chief and Zoroastrian Rectifier remain.
translations.idiomatic: Today only the two offices of Sogdian Chief and Zoroastrian Rectifier remain.

sentences.zh: 又有流外自勳品以至九品，以為諸司令史、贊者、典謁、亭長、掌固等品。

translations.literal: There were also outside-the-flow ranks from merit grade to ninth rank, for the various offices' clerks, ushers, reception attendants, station chiefs, and gatekeepers.
translations.idiomatic: There were also outside-the-flow ranks from merit grade through the ninth rank, assigned to the various offices' clerks, ushers, reception attendants, station chiefs, and gatekeepers.

sentences.zh: 視流外亦自勳品至九品，開元初唯留薩寶、祅祝及府史，餘亦罷之。

translations.literal: Quasi-outside-the-flow also ran from merit grade to ninth rank; at the beginning of Kaiyuan only Sogdian Chief, Zoroastrian Sacrificer, and mansion clerks were retained — the rest were also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Quasi-outside-the-flow ranks likewise ran from merit grade to the ninth rank; at the beginning of Kaiyuan only the Sogdian chief, zoroastrian sacrificer, and mansion clerks were kept, and the rest were abolished as well.

sentences.zh: 職事者，諸統領曹事，供命王命，上下相攝，以持庶績。

translations.literal: Substantive officers were those who directed all bureau affairs, carried out the king's commands, and coordinated superiors and subordinates to sustain the multitude of tasks.
translations.idiomatic: Substantive officers were those who directed bureau affairs, carried out the sovereign's commands, and coordinated superiors and subordinates to sustain the work of government.

sentences.zh: 近代已來，又分為文武二職，分曹置員，各理所掌。

translations.literal: In recent times they were further divided into civil and military duties, with separate bureaus and posts, each administering what it oversaw.
translations.idiomatic: In recent times the offices were further divided into civil and military tracks, with separate bureaus and posts, each administering its own sphere.

sentences.zh: 五品已上，舊制吏部尚書進用。

translations.literal: For fifth rank and above, the old system had the Minister of Personnel advance candidates.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, appointments from the fifth rank upward were advanced by the Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 自隋已後，則中書門下知政事官訪擇聞奏，然後下制授之。

translations.literal: From Sui onward, secretariat and chancellery officials handling state affairs would investigate, select, report, and only then issue an edict of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: From the Sui dynasty onward, secretariat and chancellery officials in charge of state affairs would investigate candidates, report their selection, and only then issue an edict of appointment.

sentences.zh: 三品已上，德高委重者，亦有臨軒冊授。

translations.literal: For third rank and above, when virtue was high and trust weighty, there was also investiture before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: For the third rank and above, when a man's virtue and the trust placed in him were especially great, investiture could also be performed before the throne.

sentences.zh: 自神龍之後，冊禮廢而不用，朝遷命官，制敕而已。

translations.literal: After Shenlong, the investiture ceremony was abandoned and unused; court transfers and appointments relied on edicts alone.
translations.idiomatic: After the Shenlong era, the investiture ceremony fell out of use; court transfers and appointments were made by edict alone.

sentences.zh: 六品已上，吏部選擬錄奏，書旨授之。

translations.literal: For sixth rank and above, the Ministry of Personnel selected nominees, recorded and reported them, and appointments were made by written decree.
translations.idiomatic: For the sixth rank and above, the Ministry of Personnel selected nominees, submitted a record for approval, and appointments were conveyed by written decree.

sentences.zh: 有唐已來，出身入仕者，著令有秀才、明經、進士、明法、書算。

translations.literal: Since Tang, those entering office by examination were defined in statute as cultivated talent, classics, presented scholar, law, calligraphy, and mathematics.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Tang dynasty, the statutes defined five examination routes into office: cultivated talent, classics, presented scholar, law, calligraphy, and mathematics.

sentences.zh: 其次以流外入流。

translations.literal: Next came entry into the regular sequence from outside-the-flow status.
